title: Warmest freezer reading
hints: Keep a variable with the highest value seen so far, and update it whenever you find something bigger.
The starting value is the trap: `int highest = 0;` is wrong when every reading is below zero. Start with the first element, `values[0]`, and loop from index 1.
`int highest = values[0]; for (size_t i = 1; i < count; i++) { if (values[i] > highest) highest = values[i]; } return highest;`
